label: Stopwatch
depicts: Round stopwatch face with one vertical hand and one small side knob at the upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a clean stopwatch face with a straight hand and minimal top hardware.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stopwatch with the angled hand and extra top loop around the crown.

label: Stopwatch
depicts: Round stopwatch face with one angled hand and one top loop and one small side button
use_when: Use when the interface wants the stopwatch to show a more active angled hand and a pronounced top loop crown.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plainer stopwatch when the face should not rely on the large top loop or angled hand.

label: Store
depicts: Storefront awning above one open boxy counter with no door in the base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a shop front that reads more like an open counter under an awning.
avoid_when: Do not use for the full store building when the base should show a centered door under the awning.

label: Store
depicts: Storefront awning above one square building face with one centered door in the base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fuller retail building with a clear door beneath the awning.
avoid_when: Do not use for the open counter storefront when the base should not stay empty under the awning.

label: Suitcase
depicts: Tall suitcase with one top handle and two vertical side rails framing the body
use_when: Use when the interface wants luggage to read as a taller travel case with upright side rails.
avoid_when: Do not use for the briefcase style suitcase when the front should be crossed by two horizontal bands instead of side rails.
